analysis_title: Cross-national latent construct comparison of intrinsic capacity and outcome-disjoint frailty
status: exploratory; source-audited; no cross-cohort invariance fit yet
share_exclusion_reason: wave-6 two-item locomotion CFA failed post-check because rare walkra produced boundary/negative residual variance; the fit indices alone are not accepted as measurement evidence

share_mobility_sensitivity.definition: 0=no difficulty; 1=100-metre difficulty only; 2=across-room difficulty or both

primary_comparison_design: anchor-wave within-cohort domain CFA followed by domain-level partial invariance/alignment among ELSA, CHARLS, HRS
longitudinal_extension: all available waves as sensitivity or secondary analysis after module missingness audit; SHARE wave 7 excluded from primary cognition

domain_rules.SHARE: cognition, grip_vitality, psychological retained as external exploratory domains; locomotion composite only
domain_rules.LASI: external structure validation; psychological remains single-indicator

frailty_primary.denominator_rule: minimum 6 of 8 observed; FI denominator equals number of observed components
frailty_primary.bmi_rule: BMI<18.5 or BMI>=30 primary; cohort-percentile BMI sensitivity

next_gate: compare SHARE mobility_sum and mobility_hierarchical as external/sensitivity scores
carry HRS non-proxy restriction into all IC measurement models; retain proxy respondents only for FI descriptives/sensitivity
do not claim cross-national scalar invariance before partial-invariance/alignment fit

hrs_ic_measurement_sample.proxy_role: retain in FI descriptives and sensitivity analyses
